{{Quote|Ey, Whizzah. We've been lookin' for yah. Jabba tells us you owe him some stuff. He wants dah money ... and he wants his spice.|Big Gizz|<ref name="JADW" />}}
'''Whizzer''' was an aging Twi'lek with ties to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|cartel]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], he owed Jabba both [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and [[Spice/Legends|spice]].

Whizzer was waylaid once by [[Gizman|Big Gizz]], [[Spiker]], and other members of Jabba's [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]]. In an act of intimidation, Spiker pretended to kill Whizzer, but held back at the last second. Whizzer then bribed his way out of the confrontation by allowing Big Gizz to sample some of his [[Ryll/Legends|Ryll]].
